description: Nodes with a label and properties, connected by directed, typed edges that can carry properties too. The model behind Neo4j, Cypher and ISO GQL.
For each node, the list of its outgoing and incoming edges, so finding neighbors is a lookup instead of a scan over every edge.
Visits nodes ring by ring from the start. Each node is reached first at its smallest depth, so the first path to the target has the fewest hops.
A maximum number of hops for a traversal. The frontier grows roughly as degree^depth, so most useful questions stay within two to four hops.
A node with a huge number of edges (a country, a popular tag). Traversals through it explode unless filtered by edge type and direction.
Remember how each node was first reached (previous node and edge), then walk back from the target. The path's edges become the evidence for an answer.
A question whose answer needs several connected facts, such as "teams owning services that depend on X". Expressed as a pattern of edge types and directions.
Retrieve entry entities with search, then add their neighbors from the graph, so connected facts reach the context even when no single passage mentions them together.
